stories.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate seat, beating Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan
stories.summary: The Alaska race was the last U.S. Senate contest to be resolved in this year's midterm elections and gave Democrats a 56-44 majority after they flipped nine GOP-held seats to retake the chamber.
stories.why: Officeholders can build support that outlasts party tides.
